source_message.text:
Hi Jimena
I’m looking for layout and design support for a response (proposal) to an RFP. There would be strict rules around the file size, page numbers, etc. There will also be the reality of the turnaround time being last-minute because of the nature of RFP timelines. Although I suspect the RFP will come out this month. 1) Do you have experience with this type of proposal support? 2) If so, how do you prepare for these types of timelines w/ clients,what if edits are needed from clients until its final?
